findings.desc: Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md:167-168 - `advisory_memory` and `host_transcript_memory` are defined as scoreable expected layers, but lines 84-89 exclude dev-memory and host/manual transcripts from corpus and gold truth. This makes the MemoryScore contract self-contradictory and could lead a future benchmark to score retrieval over non-authoritative sources. Severity: medium.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 7dbfbf10: advisory_memory and host_transcript_memory are now explicitly boundary-only labels and cannot enter corpus truth, gold truth, HistoricalRetrievalScore, recall, or precision.

findings.desc: Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md:135 CHK-001 promises a visible 100-point MemoryScore formula, but the doc only defines QualityScore and then uses `MemoryScore = QualityScore + 10 * ScaleStabilityScore`, forcing readers to expand the weights themselves. Fix by adding the fully expanded MemoryScore equation inline next to the helper notation so the user-visible formula is explicit.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 0e708241: added fully expanded MemoryScore formula alongside QualityScore helper notation.

findings.desc: Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md:127 adds `current-state query has stale truth hit => FAIL`, but the Failure taxonomy at Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md:204 does not name any stale-truth or freshness failure type. Fix by adding a matching taxonomy row or explicitly mapping this hard-fail path to an existing failure class so the contract stays internally consistent.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 0e708241: added staleTruthHit to Failure taxonomy for current-state stale truth hard fail.

findings.desc: .koala/story/actives/B-4980/checklist.json:61 refreshed CHK-001 verificationEvidence covers thresholds and authority wording, but it never asserts the new hard-fail taxonomy entry at Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md:218 (`staleTruthHit`). Expanded formula, boundary-only labels, and non-authority wording are covered elsewhere, but this missing docs_check leaves the refreshed evidence incomplete for the added failure taxonomy. severity: medium
findings.resolvedReason: Added explicit CHK-001:edge:0 docs_check evidence for staleTruthHit taxonomy via verification_evidence_add.
